projects.title: Speaking Partner Mira
projects.desc:
Mira is an AI-powered speaking partner featuring an interactive 3D avatar that responds to users' questions and engages in natural conversations. It is designed to help users improve their English-speaking skills, fluency, and confidence through regular practice.

Many students and individuals can understand, read, and write English but struggle to speak it fluently and confidently. Mira aims to bridge this gap by providing a friendly, comfortable, and judgment-free environment where users can practice speaking without hesitation or fear of making mistakes.

With its gentle voice, friendly tone, and clear, well-structured responses, Mira makes English learning more engaging, interactive, and effective. Through continuous conversations, users can gradually overcome their fear of speaking English and develop better communication skills.

projects.title: Personal Hand Rehabilitation Assistant
projects.desc: Developed a portable, home-based bilateral smart glove system for post-stroke hand rehabilitation that integrates mirror therapy with real-time sensor motion tracking and motor-assisted actuation. The healthy-hand transmitter glove uses a calibrated flex sensor on the index finger to measure bending angles and a palmar force-sensitive resistor (FSR) to detect grip force, processed by an ESP32 microcontroller and transmitted wirelessly with minimal latency. On the paralyzed-hand receiver glove, a second ESP32 and a PCA9685 motor driver control five MG996R servo motors on a custom PCB/Veroboard circuit—proportionally replicating finger flexion and triggering synchronized multi-finger grasping based on palmar grip pressure while mitigating power fluctuations and servo jitter.

projects.title: MotionMirror — WebRTC Telerehabilitation & 3D Mirror Therapy App
projects.desc: Full-stack telemedicine platform (Next.js / Firebase / WebRTC) combining real-time doctor-patient video consultations, remote pneumatic therapy controls, camera-driven individual finger tracking, and interactive 3D mirror-therapy hand visualization.

projects.title: Hybrid MDM-LDA BCI Framework for Stroke Motor Imagery Classification
projects.desc: First-author IEEE conference research (QPAIN / ICCIT 2026) decoding motor imagery EEG from 50 stroke patients. Extracted 449 Riemannian covariance tangent-space and inter-hemispheric coherence features across 19 sub-bands (8–30 Hz), achieving 82.0% mean accuracy (κ = 0.62) and 81.14% macro F1.

projects.title: Skin Cancer Classification Using Deep Learning (EfficientNet-B2)
projects.desc: Fine-tuned a 7-class EfficientNet-B2 CNN on ~10,000 dermatoscopic images (HAM10000) using lesion-ID-based splitting to prevent data leakage, class-weighted cross-entropy, and cosine annealing. Achieved 79.63% test accuracy, 0.8075 weighted F1, and 0.9522 mean ROC-AUC.

projects.title: Smart Pregnancy Pain-Relief Wearable Belt & Non-Invasive Bilirubin Detector
projects.desc: ESP32 wearable Body Sensor Network integrating FSR pressure and DHT22 thermal sensors with dual vibration actuators and a MIT App Inventor Wi-Fi control app (~3,500 BDT prototype). Also developed a non-invasive optical PPG bilirubin detector using an OPT101P photodiode and tri-wavelength light.

projects.title: IoT Hospital Critical-Care Environmental Monitoring System
projects.desc: ESP32-based clinical telemetry node acquiring real-time temperature, humidity (DHT22), and air-quality/gas (MQ-135) measurements with live Blynk cloud dashboards and automated threshold alerting for hospital ICUs and wards.

projects.title: Smart Email Router & Weather Alert Bot with n8n
projects.desc: Built two n8n automations: a Gmail-to-Telegram notifier using Gemini to summarise email subjects, and a city-based weather bot using WeatherAPI. Integrated webhooks, JavaScript logic, request validation, and formatted weather responses.
